purpose: MDB Precompute Category: own import-object and direct-picture-track native predicate, exact bin-display checkbox label bridge, actual selected-master input audit, MDVx ordinary omission and proposed compact Bella retention.
status: User approved Precompute Category rules on 20 October 2026, including blank unreadable/unavailable display/export, compact storage and the verified direct-master predicate. Not yet implemented; OldScanner active and Bin Filter unchanged. Original raw findings retain their pre-approval wording; agreedBellaRule records the final decision.

mediaComposer.scope: Bounded read-only static research for Bella MDB Precompute Category. This is the native two-category bin-display classifier for an already qualified precompute master, not a stored category string, a complete UI clone, or a generic imported-media classifier. No app/private API execution, media writes, repository edits or runtime implementation.
plainMeaning: After Type is already Precompute, Avid puts the selected master into one of two broad bin-display groups: Rendered Effects, or Titles and Matte Keys.

It checks whether that same master has an exact direct object attribute named _IMPORTSETTING. If it does, it counts the master immediate picture tracks. At least two puts it in Titles and Matte Keys; otherwise it uses Rendered Effects.
The import attribute contents are not parsed for this category. The native test is typed presence, not a filename/clip-name/effect-name guess, a prefix match or a count of physical files.

There is no third Imported category in this two-category precompute predicate. Ordinary linked/imported master clips use other bin-display branches; they must not be promoted to Precompute by this attribute alone.

owner: 0x2ab7dc..e0 calls virtual+0x250. For AComposition this resolves to AComponent::GetAttrList0x1498f8, which directly returns member+self+0x40.
No _USER lookup, source/master ancestry, nested attribute traversal or global search occurs in this helper.
name: 0x2ab7f4 supplies the literal exact name _IMPORTSETTING to FindObject.

CoreAttrList::FindAttr0x6cc7c uses its ordered_unique attribute-name index; its find implementation0x6cd68 compares names with strcmp at0x6cd98/0x6cdc8. Matching is case-sensitive and exact; _IMPORTSETTING_suffix is not the same name.
kind: Core FindObject0x6e828 supplies kind3 to FindAttr. FindAttr0x6ccc0..ccd8 checks the named entry kind and stores the found flag. A readable wrong-kind same-name entry yields false and null; no second search or recursive fallback occurs.
The native in-memory index is unique by name. It does not settle how Bella should repair contradictory duplicate entries in a damaged raw MDB; Bella should not choose by record order.
nullObjectPayload: On kind/name match, FindAttr stores found=true at0x6cccc..ccd0 and then loads payload pointer at0x6ccf4. A null pointer can therefore accompany true.
GetImportSettingAttrList0x2ab804 returns the found flag, independently of the payload pointer it writes to the output parameter.

brDisplayable tests that flag and never reads the pointed object contents. Therefore null object payload does not make the native typed-presence test false. A missing/damaged raw reference and overall MDB structural handling remain separately defined parser concerns; this fact does not authorize inventing a valid nested import-setting object.
attributeSearch.wireAndText: For actual MDB storage, the logical route is selected master CPNT:Attributes→ATTR:AttrRefs→ATTB Name/Kind. The relevant exact name is ASCII, so its byte spelling is common to the already supported legacy text encoding and UTF-8. Kind3 is numeric object-attribute kind. The raw-file inventory independently verifies actual declared types/widths/byte order. No category string, UTF-8 payload or import-setting contents need to be decoded for this predicate.

bellaRecommendationPendingApproval: Only compute this optional category for a row whose selected master Type is already proven Precompute. Ordinary Media and unknown Type do not get guessed precompute categories.
Read the selected master own exact-name typed object-attribute presence. A confirmed absence can classify Rendered Effects without reading tracks or decoding the object payload.

When it is present, inspect only required immediate track-component kind values. Once at least two readable picture tracks are established, the threshold is proven; where fewer than two are found, the relevant enumeration must be complete before asserting Rendered Effects. Early stopping is a Bella efficiency choice, not the traced native loop schedule.

Unreadable/conflicting necessary attribute-list or track information leaves category Unknown while keeping the already known Type, row and optional details feature behavior. Do not interpret a failed read as confirmed absence.

Keep a compact category enum and availability information, and format the existing Rendered Effects / Titles and Matte Keys labels at presentation. Do not retain a full nested import object or complete metadata graph solely for this category.
Keep Effect Category, Effect and Effect Sequence inference separate. This two-category predicate does not establish those names or timeline association, and does not alter Bin Filter.
limits: The classifier and its exact two visible toggle identities are traced; no claim that every Media Composer UI uses the same complete path.
No new writer format for category exists in this finding: the category is derived from master usage/attributes/tracks rather than read as a stored category scalar.
Fresh binary facts are independent of current MediaMuster output. Raw-corpus counts and malformed/missing layout coverage are a separate data-agent review.

mdvx.purpose: Determine whether installed MDVx ordinary MDB inventory derives a separate precompute category such as Titles and Matte Keys versus Rendered Effects.
mdvx.method: Fresh installed SHA256; bounded rereading of exact retained functions for that identical binary. Prior direct usage-label decoding is tied to the same hash. Current MediaMuster precompute.h was read only for terminology, not proof of native Media Composer code. No live app, UI, scanner, CSV, private API, new MDB/media read or production edit.
mdvx.mainFinding: No separate Precompute Category is projected in the traced ordinary scan-to-row-to-table/CSV/filter path. MDVx stores master UsageCode and may replace it with a name-prefix import override in the same scalar. That does not establish Titles/Matte Keys versus Rendered Effects.

currentTerminologyContextOnly.predicate: Current MediaMuster calls its pure predicate only after proving a precompute master. Confirmed absent import object selects renders. actualDatabases.purpose: Independent actual MDB selected-master input audit for proposed Precompute Category, without treating current production classification as an oracle.
method: Fresh hashes of six current MDBs, six paired PMRs and six retained value indexes match the Type receipt, with stable stat identity during each read.

Every retained full-ID, catalogue, physical-descriptor reference, class, usage, attribute/reference/name/kind and direct track/component/kind property is reconstructed from actual MDB byte ranges and compared byte-for-byte with its cached value.

Complete normalized PMR file and master IDs select their unique catalogue-qualified physical FileMob and associated nonphysical master. The selected own master, its direct CPNT Attributes and direct TRKG Tracks are the only category input owners.

Attribute enumeration reads only master CPNT Attributes -> ATTR AttrRefs -> ATTB Name/Kind. Relevant exact _IMPORTSETTING entries and direct _AT-prefixed keys are recorded separately. No _USER, nested import-setting contents, ancestor, unrelated master or arbitrary recursive attributes supply an input.

Attribute Kind must be concrete omfi:AttrKind, two bytes. Object payload reference state, target existence/class, duplicate entries, different kinds and different targets are reported independently from exact name/kind matching.

Direct track order comes from concrete ObjRefArray count and eight-byte entries. Each TRAK own TrackComponent must resolve to exactly one component, whose own CPNT TrackKind must be concrete omfi:TrackType, two bytes. Value 1 is counted separately; all other observed raw kinds and component classes are retained. No deeper segment walk supplies direct track kind.
Physical-row and distinct-master combinations are separate. The 171 physical rows with usage 1 do not imply 171 distinct master objects. Usage 7 controls are audited independently.

Raw input combinations remain separate from the explicit native-predicate application summary. The latter applies the independently reported native rule for comparison, not approval of a Bella policy or an OldScanner classification output. Reading src/precompute.h and the current classifier scoped candidate inputs; their outputs were not read or treated as evidence.
No physical media header or essence is opened. No repo, app, media or input file is written.
limits: This probe inventories current raw inputs and does not approve a Precompute Category rule or use an OldScanner output as an oracle.
Native found-flag semantics and null object payload handling have separate native proof. Exact name/kind presence and object payload validity remain separate raw observations.

A complete unrelated direct attribute does not become a category input. _AT-prefixed import/capture/CRM names are context only and do not participate in the independently established two-category native predicate.
Absence and complete/damaged/conflicting closures remain separate observations. Unexercised missing, duplicate, conflicting and invalid fields do not define runtime policy.
All observed inputs use established little-endian legacy MDB layouts; no other container, field representation or endianness is approved.
Counts of property shapes on distinct master traversals are owner-scoped visits; shared child objects can recur through different masters. Master counts themselves are deduplicated per MDB.
Already approved Type and unique absent-master recovery policies are unchanged.

nativePredicateApplicationNotBellaApprov.status: Application of separately established native predicate to verified raw inputs; proposed Bella rule remains unapproved.
nativePredicateApplicationNotBellaApprov.predicate: Only after selected master usage 1: exact direct _IMPORTSETTING Kind3 object-attribute found plus at least two direct component TrackKind1 slots selects Titles and Matte Keys; confirmed absence or fewer than two selects Rendered Effects. A null object payload still counts as found; object target contents are not read.

agreedBellaRule.status: Approved by the user on 20 October 2026; not yet implemented.
agreedBellaRule.gatingAndOwner: Only the already selected qualified associated master established as Precompute (UsageCode 1); reuse same master as Type/Clip Name/Original Bin. Unknown or Media Type does not acquire a category through this predicate.
agreedBellaRule.inputs: Exact own direct _IMPORTSETTING object attribute, Kind3; if present, immediate master track-component CPNT:TrackKind1 count. No prefix/nested matching, no import-settings body, no recorded Source Path.

mapping.trackReadRequired: Only when needed for the decisive branch

agreedBellaRule.nullObjectPayload: Matching object-attribute found flag is independent of the object pointer. Null target can qualify as found; no import-body traversal or target-content read is required by this predicate.
agreedBellaRule.retention: Small category enum and necessary availability. Read/derive once per selected master and reuse for associated physical rows during database processing. Reuse own direct attribute facts already needed by retained metadata. No formatted category label or permanent attribute/track/object graph solely for category.
agreedBellaRule.presentation: Rendered Effects / Titles and Matte Keys; blank table/CSV for unreadable or otherwise unavailable category and for inapplicable ordinary Media. This approved change replaces OldScanner lowercase unknown for Category cells; explicit Unknown filtering remains distinct.
agreedBellaRule.filterCompatibility: Keep explicit Unknown category for optional category filtering, distinct from blank table/CSV presentation and empty-string wildcard paths. Preserve optional feature and existing filtering meaning.
agreedBellaRule.implementationBuildingBlocks: Carry verified interpretation/useful cases into small new C++17 pure helper and scoped enums/value records. Use checked typed/endian Qt6.5.3 adapter access. No C++20 constructs.
agreedBellaRule.separateDecisions: Optional Effect Category/Effect/Effect Sequence retained. General MDB damage/layout coverage, source precedence, header-read conditions and scheduling remain separate. Bin Filter unchanged.
